question: Which offices may reproduce member and claim columns (member email, claimant and assignee identifiers, claim status and dates, dues amounts) in a free-form report, which columns are releasable at all, and what must be recorded and suppressed when a report returns them?
decision: Saved and executed reports inherit the exact source row/column authorization of the requesting user, not a blanket officer threshold. Member identities and case attributes require a named privacy/representation mandate; dues amounts require a financial mandate; privileged WSIB/medical text is excluded absent case-specific grant. Log source, columns, row count, purpose and exports, apply redaction and minimum-cell rules for aggregate sharing, and prevent report definitions from bypassing RLS.
originalProposedDecision: Officers and admins only. Releasable member columns: name, membership status, unit. Email, claimant and assignee ids and dues amounts need the finance or privacy officer floor. Every run with member-level columns is audit-logged with the column list.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
